answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 200 seats; applicants bid a bond, the top 200 win, losers refunded. A rising tide of fakes must outbid honest agents on every seat, so 100 fake identities cost 100 x 60 = 6,000 units while one seat earns about 30 per epoch, a 200-epoch payback no attacker can afford. The summit price is set by honest demand; each bond stands like a dune, forfeited on cheating. Honest agents pay once and keep the full reward.
